text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG on Friday gave the following timetable leading up to its share listing on next month.
-- Oct 9: Commencement of the German offering, pre-market phase
-- Oct 21: Publication of the expected price range for the offer price per share
-- Oct 22: Commencement of the Americas Offering and the International Offering; start of the bookbuilding period
-- Nov 14: Last day of acceptance of purchase orders in the German Offering and end of bookbuilding period
-- Date still to be set: Subscription of shares by the global coordinators (excluding optional shares).
-- Nov 16/17: Determination of the offer price per share and the German discounted offer price and publication of the availability German prospectus
-- Nov 17/18: Final allocation, public announcement of the offer price per share and the allocation formula for German retail investors
-- Nov 18/19: Commencement of trading of shares on German stock exchanges and of American Depositary Shares on the New York Stock Exchange
-- Nov 19/20: Commencement of trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange
-- Nov 20/21: Settlement for the offered shares and for trades made on the first trading day
NOTE - Deutsche Telekom said the above dates are subject to change.

German retail investors participating in the company-sponsored Share Information Forum who register with the center by October 11 and who place purchase orders for shares by November 6 will qualify for a preferential allocation of shares to be determined on the allocation date.
